Frequently asked questions

Which vaults & password managers tool is best?

Our top pick is Bitwarden. See each tool's verdict for who it suits and who should skip it.

Are there free vaults & password managers options?

Yes: Bitwarden, LastPass Emergency Access have a free option. Check the official pricing page before you buy.

Which of these work outside the US?

Bitwarden, Keeper, Proton Pass (Proton Emergency Access), 1Password, LastPass Emergency Access, Dashlane are available globally.
